facts.text: Marcus pretending to be Mike Lowrey; Julie Mott, the witness who will not cooperate
facts.why: Julie does not refuse to cooperate. She insists on talking only to Mike, and Captain Howard makes Marcus pose as Mike so she will talk.
facts.fix: Marcus pretending to be Mike Lowrey; Julie Mott, the witness who will only talk to Mike

facts.text: Two cops, one apartment, and nothing in the fridge. Switch names and put the pizza on Mike's card.
facts.why: They do not share one apartment. Howard has them swap lives, with Mike living at the Burnett house and Marcus staying with Julie at Mike's. The nothing-in-the-fridge claim is also not in the film.
facts.fix: I'm Mike this week and Mike's eating my wife's cooking. Put the pizza on his card.
